name: Anomalous Meterpreter / Remote Access C2 Port Connection
description: Alerts when an app initiates an outbound socket on well-known offensive reverse shell ports (e.g. 4444 Metasploit, 1337 Elite, 31337 BackOrifice, 5555 unauthorized ADB over TCP).
remediation: Isolate the device network connection immediately and terminate suspicious background process.
